dataPeriods.holdoutEndPolicy: latest available session with a complete 5D forward label

compositeDefinition.interpretation: higher score = stronger expected systematic equity buying pressure
compositeDefinition.normalization: For each module observation, apply sign orientation first, then ECDF using only eligible observations of that same module with firstTradableSession strictly earlier than the current module firstTradableSession.
compositeDefinition.aggregation: equal-weight arithmetic mean of active module scores
compositeDefinition.failClosedRule: If any required core module is not status ok, lacks its primary raw signal, lacks timing metadata, or lacks prior ECDF history, the composite row is insufficient_data.

pensionRebalance.inactivePolicy: exclude from numerator and denominator; never fill zero

statistics.bootstrapMethod: overlapping moving blocks, sample with replacement, concatenate, truncate to N, no circular wrap
statistics.icGate: Spearman direction correct AND two-sided HAC p < 0.05 AND 95% moving-block percentile CI excludes zero in expected direction AND Partial Rank IC direction preserved
statistics.partialRankIC: corr(resid(rank(composite)), resid(rank(outcome))) after both are residualized by OLS with intercept against rank(momentumRaw) and rank(vol20Raw) on the same complete-case development sample

oos.baselineAsOf: last completed ^GSPC session strictly before compositeFirstTradableSession
oos.enhanced: y = alpha + beta * (z_mom - z_vol) + gamma * compositeScore
oos.estimator: OLS with intercept; no interactions; no regularization; no hyperparameter tuning
oos.baselineNormalization: training-window-only mean/std, ddof=1, fixed for entire test year
oos.commonSample: baseline and enhanced use exactly the same train and test rows
oos.formalGate: mean(d_t) > 0 AND two-sided intercept-only HAC p < 0.05 AND 95% moving-block bootstrap lower bound > 0

finalGate.supportedCondition: primary 5D IC gate passes AND true 2025-2026 pooled OOS gate passes AND all development robustness rules pass
